race.comment: NEW SHERIFF (1) has been hard to follow lately, running sixth (25.98) last time but prior to that ran very well when placed at Bendigo. Key player on best and worth another chance. AMRON TOMMY (7) has a strong winning strike-rate here with three wins and a placing from eight tries. Below best last time at this track (25.70) in a Grade 5, finishing a 6 length seventh. Can feature with the right run. HARD COMPASS (3) was midfield throughout and finished there last time when 4th (24.07) at Bendigo. One of the better chances. RITA PAIGE (6) placed last start and is in the mix again.
